title: My 9 Favorite Pickleball Paddles From 3 Years of Testing (2026)
summary: Paddles are getting more sophisticated and expensive. We’ve tested 100+ over the years to find our favorites.
llm_summary: Over the past three years, we’ve put more than 100 pickleball paddles through rigorous testing, tracking everything from material composition to performance on the court. The results show that modern paddles have become far more sophisticated—and pricey—thanks to advances in carbon‑fiber cores, polymer faces, and weight‑distribution engineering. Below are our nine top picks, each representing the best blend of power, control, durability, and tech‑
